libs.note: BH-7599. The write gate of the web-task lane: in write mode (`Mode: write` in the ticket body) every action that reads as a write waits for one Approve through S5's wh_request_human (kind approve) with a screenshot of the filled form. Cancel or no answer stops the run with nothing written. Payment pages are refused in every mode unless their host is in ALLOW_PAYMENT_SITES (row lane.web-task.<project>.allow_payment_sites). Slice C1 of #7599 wires it into the web-task agent loop.

knobs.note: How long the write gate waits for an Approve or Cancel before it stops the run with `stopped: no approval for write <n> in <s>s; nothing written`. The default equals S5's web_task.human_wait_s seed. A value that is not an integer in 10..3600 makes createWriteGate throw; it is never clamped. Read by createWriteGate as env WEB_TASK_WRITE_WAIT_S, fallback 300.
